info.text:
# Pokemon XD: Gale of Darkness

## Where is the options page?

The player options page for this game contains the options you need to configure and export a config file.

## What does randomization do to this game?

AP client talks to a Dolphin process over its
memory -- see the setup guide for what it can and can't do automatically. Several kinds of check are shuffled:

- **Overworld items** -- chests, NPC gifts, and found items in the field.
- **Opening a chest** -- unique per chest location.
- **Trainer defeats** -- defeating a unique trainer, or, in Cumulative mode, "Defeat 1 Trainers" through "Defeat
  X Trainers".
- **Catching a species** -- one check per species you can actually obtain in your seed (its Shadow Pokemon, its
  Poke Spot species and your starter), the first time that species is seen owned, live-detected off the game's
  own memory.
- **Purifying a Shadow Pokemon** -- Cumulative checks, "Purify 1 Shadow Pokemon" through "Purify X Shadow
  Pokemon", one per Shadow Pokemon your seed holds that can be had before the goal. Greevil's Shadow Pokemon and
  Miror B.'s post-game Dragonite have no checks.
- **Shop purchases** -- shelf slots in the shops, when shop randomization is on.

Every check grants an ordinary shuffled item from the multiworld.

## What is the goal of Pokemon XD?

Chosen with the Goal option:

- **Defeat Greevil** (default) -- reach Citadark Isle and defeat Cipher's boss, Greevil, having gathered the key
  items (or Robo Kyogre Parts) needed to get there.
- **Win Mt. Battle** -- defeat the final trainer on Mt. Battle.

## What does another world's item look like in this game?

Not yet defined -- the client doesn't currently render a distinct "foreign item" indicator in-game.

## Known issues

- Location shuffle is experimental. Issues and softlocks are definitely possible. Please report all bugs if you can.

# Pokemon XD: Gale of Darkness -- Setup Guide ## Installing 1. **Double-click `pokemon_xd.apworld`**, right click -> Open With -> find your archipelago launcher exe, or use the Launcher's "Install APWorld" button and pick it. Then **restart the Launcher**. Do not drag the file into a folder yourself unless you have read the next section, because two things about a dropped-in file have to be exactly right and neither one reports what went wrong. If the world does not load you get no "Pokemon XD Client" button in the Launcher and no Pokemon XD entry from "Generate Template Options".
If you install it by hand anyway -- the two things that have to be right **The filename must be exactly `pokemon_xd.apworld`.** | Your install | Where to put it | |---|---| | Portable, or running from source | `/custom_worlds/` | | Installed (Windows `Program Files`, frozen macOS) | `%USERPROFILE%\Archipelago\worlds\` (Windows) or `~/Archipelago/worlds/` | If you are not sure which you have, install by double-clicking and let Archipelago decide.
2. You'll need Dolphin and your own legally-owned Pokemon XD: Gale of Darkness (USA, game code `GXXE`) ISO. ## Generating a YAML 1. Use the Launcher's "Generate Template Options" to produce a default YAML for Pokemon XD Gale of Darkness, or use `docs/Pokemon XD Gale of Darkness.yaml` in this package as a starting point. 2. Set your `name` in the YAML to anything you like, up to Archipelago's 16 characters. It does **not** have to match your in-game trainer name -- the client finds your save without it. 3. If hosting, put the YAML in your `Players` folder. Use "Generate" in the Archipelago launcher to create the zip file. Host the same as any other multiworld. ## Patching 1. On your Archipelago world page, your slot should have a patch to download (the .appxd file). Download it. 2. Right click it -> open with -> find your Archipelago Launcher exe. This should allow you to just double click them in the future. 3. Select your **UNPATCHED** ISO/CISO file. 4. Write a name for your new ISO/CISO. Make sure not to delete the file extension (.iso or .ciso) 5. Allow the patch to finish - it usually takes a minute or two, depending on settings. A console shows progress. ## Playing 1. Boot Dolphin and load your own Pokemon XD ISO - DO NOT OPEN THE POKEMON XD ARCHIPELAGO CLIENT YET. 2. Start a new save file or continue one. 3. In-game, name your trainer whatever you like. 4. **Finish the intro fight and save the game before connecting the client.** This gives you a clean fallback to reload from if anything goes wrong during your first connection/sync, and it is worth saving again periodically as you play. 5. Open your party menu at least once. 6. Launch the client and connect to your room - enter your slot name. 7. Play. **Please save after acquiring the Snag Machine. Save often for your own sake.** --- ## Things worth knowing before you play - **Location Shuffle is experimental.** It is my preferred way to play this game and the most likely to break. Only run it with a group that is happy to hit bugs and report them until I can test further. - **Cumulative trainer defeats + Location Shuffle can softlock.** If you use both, keep the defeat count low. - **Catch checks holding progression** is off by default, and should stay off unless you intend to catch every Shadow Pokemon as it comes up. - **Save often.** The client writes to live memory; saves are handy. - **Some areas require other story segments.** Namely, ONBS raid will be triggered upon finishing Pyrite's initial storyline (up to being sent away to the pokespots) and fighting Miror B at the Cave Poke spot. - **Save states work, but may cause issues if used immediately after a reboot. Feel free to report bugs.** --- ## Client commands Most are diagnostics prefixed `DEBUG:` in their help text. The ones you are most likely to want: | | | |---|---| | `/mirorforce ` | Put Miror B. at pyrite, realgam, rock, oasis or cave on your next step | | `/keyitems` | Which gating key items you currently hold | | `/parts` | Robo Kyogre Part progress | | `/remaining` | Overworld Item locations you have not checked yet | | `/goal` | Force the goal, if you beat it and the check did not send | `/help` lists the rest. --- ## Reporting a bug Say what you were doing, which options you had on, and paste the client log around the moment it went wrong. If the story looks wrong, `/story` and `/storylog` together are usually enough to help me.

readme.text:
# Pokemon XD: Gale of Darkness — Archipelago apworld

An Archipelago world for the GameCube game *Pokemon XD: Gale of Darkness* (USA, `GXXE`).

---

## What's in a seed

| | |
|---|---|
| Locations | About 600 with default options, up to about 700 |
| Items | 225 (134 of them filler) |
| YAML options | 74 |

**Check categories**

- **Overworld items** — 94 chests plus some NPC gifts and field pickups.
- **Trainer defeats** — one check per trainer, plus a "Defeat X (Any)" for trainers you can fight more than once
  (only the five forced second fights keep their own numbered check), or a cumulative "Defeat N Trainers",
  depending on the mode you pick. With Exclude Mt. Battle Trainers off, each Mt. Battle trainer is a check too.
- **Shadow Pokemon catches** — vanilla roster, plus up to 44 more if you turn on Shadow
  Pokemon Expansion.
- **Purifications** — "Purify 1 Shadow Pokemon" through "Purify X".
- **Species catches** — one per entry, 1–386.
- **Shop purchases** — every shop slot becomes its own check when Randomize Shops is on.
- **Travel unlocks** — 11 fast-travel destinations become items when Location Shuffle is on.

**Goal:** reach Citadark Isle and beat Cipher's boss — or win Mt. Battle, if you set that goal instead.

---

## Getting started

# Pokemon XD: Gale of Darkness -- Setup Guide

## Installing

1. **Double-click `pokemon_xd.apworld`**, right click -> Open With -> find your archipelago launcher exe, or use the Launcher's "Install APWorld" button and pick it.
   Archipelago copies the file where it actually looks and gives it the name it needs. Then **restart the Launcher**.
   
2. You'll need Dolphin and your own legally-owned Pokemon XD: Gale of Darkness (USA,
   game code `GXXE`) ISO.

## Generating a YAML

1. Use the Launcher's "Generate Template Options" to produce a default YAML for Pokemon XD Gale of Darkness, or
   use `docs/Pokemon XD Gale of Darkness.yaml` in this package as a starting point.
2. If hosting, put the YAML in your `Players` folder. Use "Generate" in the Archipelago launcher to create the zip file. Host the same as any other multiworld.

## Patching

1. On your Archipelago world page, your slot should have a patch to download (the .appxd file). Download it.
2. Right click it -> open with -> find your Archipelago Launcher exe. This should allow you to just double click them in the future.
3. Select your **UNPATCHED** ISO/CISO file.
4. Write a name for your new ISO/CISO. Make sure not to delete the file extension (.iso or .ciso)
5. Allow the patch to finish - it usually takes a minute or two, depending on settings. A console shows progress.

## Playing

1. Boot Dolphin and load your own Pokemon XD ISO - DO NOT OPEN THE POKEMON XD ARCHIPELAGO CLIENT YET.
2. Start a new save file or continue one.
3. **Finish the intro fight and save the game before connecting the client.** You can backup save files in the Dolphin folders if needed.
4. Open your party menu at least once.
5. Launch the client and connect to your room - enter your slot name.
6. Play. **Please save after acquiring the Snag Machine. Save often for your own sake.**
---

## Things worth knowing before you play

- **Location Shuffle is experimental.** It is my preferred way to play this game and the most likely
  to break. Only run it with a group that is happy to hit bugs and report them until I can test further.
- **Cumulative trainer defeats + Location Shuffle can softlock.** If you use both, keep the defeat count low.
- **Catch checks holding progression** is off by default, and should stay off unless you intend to catch
  every Shadow Pokemon as it comes up.
- **Save often.** The client writes to live memory. saves are handy.
- **Some areas require other story segments.** Namely, ONBS raid will be triggered upon finishing Pyrite's
  initial storyline (up to being sent away to the pokespots) and fighting Miror B at the Cave Poke spot.
- **Save states work, but may cause issues if used immediately after a reboot. Feel free to report bugs.**
- **Escape Rope.** It's always in your Key Items and takes you straight to the world map. Using it in the middle of
  a story sequence (a cutscene area, the SS Libra, Citadark Isle) can leave the story somewhere it doesn't expect. Save first.

---

## Client commands

Most are diagnostics prefixed `DEBUG:` in their help text. The ones you are most likely to want:

| | |
|---|---|
| `/mirorforce <place>` | Put Miror B. at pyrite, realgam, rock, oasis or cave on your next step |
| `/keyitems` | Which key items you currently hold |
| `/parts` | Robo Kyogre Part progress |
| `/remaining` | Overworld Item locations you have not checked yet |
| `/goal` | Force the goal, if you beat it and the check did not send |
| `/catches` | Where each species can be caught this seed |
| `/animations on\|off` | Turn move animations on or off, whatever the YAML says |
| `/toggledeathlink on\|off` | Turn Death Link on or off for this slot |
| `/pokespots` | Each Poke Spot's snacks, waiting Pokemon and Miror B.'s location |
| `/missableshadows` | Shadows on missable trainers this seed, and which went to Miror B. |

`/help` lists the rest.

---

## Reporting a bug

Say what you were doing, which options you had on, and paste the client log around the moment it went wrong.
If the story looks wrong, `/story` and `/storylog` together are usually enough to help me.

---

## Credits and license

Game data is extracted from your own disc at patch time. See `pokemon_xd/NOTICE.md` for third-party notices.

notes.text:
## Options

- **New: Kaminko Missable Trainers** (off, experimental). Missed one-time trainers wait outside Kaminko's House instead of having their checks sent for you. See below.
- **New: Citadark Admins Only** (off). Only Lovrina, Snattle, Ardos, Gorigan, Eldes and Greevil fight on Citadark Isle. The rest are marked beaten and gone, with no checks, and their Shadows move elsewhere. Works with Nightmare Citadark.
- **New: Skip Opening Movie** (off). New Game goes straight to the HQ Lab. It's part of the patch, so it works before the client connects.
- **New: Increased Walk Speed** (off). You walk at double speed - added by Rotobash (Pull request #19.)
- **Robo Kyogre Parts Required** goes up to max of 40 (was 20).
- **Nightmare Citadark and Nightmare Greevil turn on Reduce Citadark Grind** if your YAML has it off. If you picked a Reduce Citadark Grind setting yourself, it's kept.

## Checks

- **Citadark Isle's chests are named.**

- **Gateon's shop checks run 1–14 with no gap.**

## Logic

- **Shadow catches are in logic as soon as their fight is.** The backup for a Shadow you knocked out used to be the Poke Spots, after Pyrite. It's now Miror B. outside Kaminko's House, open from the start.
- **Chobin never gets a Shadow.** A Shadow on his late Robo Groudon fight was counted the moment Kaminko's House was reachable.

## Kaminko's House

**Miror B.** is teaching Kaminko the art of the groove.
- While he's holding Shadows that got away, he fights you for them with his Poke Spot team.
- Snag one and it leaves his queue everywhere.
- Beating him there sends no Miror B. defeat checks.

**Kaminko Missable Trainers (experimental option)**
- The client fills Kaminko's House with missable trainers you missed and haven't beaten, and each trainer shows up with their own overworld model.
- Each trainer says who they are and asks to battle. A win sends their usual "Defeat –" check. Beaten trainers leave, and later visits fill the gaps.
- A Shadow on one stays with them for that fight. Win without snagging it, and it runs to Miror B., who's standing right there.

## Story and travel

- **The Music Disc scene no longer repeats.**
- **The ID Card and Data ROM chests are (I think) fixed.**
- **Lovrina #2, Grason and Litnar now appear on Citadark Isle.**
- **The HQ Lab hold only ever lowers the lab.** An early Machine Part from the multiworld no longer jumps the lab ahead.
- **Every room plays its own music.**
- **After a crash or reload, the Snag Machine comes back.** If the HQ Lab is past 0x03 and you don't have the Snag Machine, you're given it, Kaminko's House is opened on the map, and Naps's Shadow goes to Miror B. if you never snagged it.
 
## Trainers

- **Mt. Battle's teams are randomized when Exclude Mt. Battle Trainers is off**: new species and movesets by the same rules as story trainers. With the option on, Mt. Battle stays vanilla.

---

## Shadow Pokemon

- **Generation III species are read correctly** in the Shadow scan and the PC fallback. A Sceptile or Gardevoir could be misread as another species, so purifications could be misnamed or double-counted.

## Wonder trades (new)

Trade with your multiworld's Emerald and Crystal players, both ways.
- `/wondertrade send <box> <slot>` sends a PC Pokemon, `/wondertrade box <n>` lists a box, and `/wondertrade` shows the status.
- One at a time: send one, and the next Pokemon another player sends lands in your first free PC slot. Save after each send and each arrival.
- Unpurified Shadows, eggs, Bonsly and Munchlax can't be sent. Shadow moves, moves the other game doesn't have, and the items this randomizer uses for checks are left off.
- A traded-in Pokemon never counts as a catch or a purification.

## Client

- **Switching seeds in one client run starts clean**, and any purification count the server never got is sent again.
- **Guaranteed Catches is kept true in the running game.** If the game is missing the always-catch code or any catch rate is below 255 (an ISO patched without it, or a save state from another build), the client writes them back and says so.
- **Perr's Machine Part is also sent** when the Machine Part hold has pulled the story back from his scene, or Gateon's remembered story mark has reached it.
- **New commands:** `/kaminko`, `/mirorqueue`, `/saveclock`, `/wondertrade`, `/mirorforce kaminko`, and `/openkaminko` (debug).
- **`/pokespotforce rock|oasis|cave [number or name]`** puts one of that spot's Pokemon there, waiting for you, even with no Poke Snacks. No arguments lists who is there.
